empty.title: Choose a voice or create a new one
empty.body: Pick a voice on the left to edit its reference audio, set its defaults and listen to it. New voices can be designed from a caption, or made from audio files, microphone recordings or a speaker embedding.

list.empty: No voices yet. Create one with the buttons above or import a voice package.

buttonHints.designed: Describe the voice, then pick a candidate
buttonHints.recorded: Read sample sentences for about 30 s

titles.designed: Design a voice from a caption
titles.imported: Create a voice from audio files
titles.embedding: Create a voice from a speaker embedding

intros.designed: Describe the voice, generate candidates and save the one you like. Its audio becomes the voice's reference, so the voice stays the same from then on.
intros.imported: Add recordings of one person. Clean audio with little noise, 30 seconds or more in total (up to 120), gives the most stable voice.
intros.recorded: Read the sample sentences aloud, one take per sentence. Aim for about 30 seconds in total.
intros.embedding: Import a speaker embedding (.speaker.safetensors) made with Speaker Inversion into the library.

clips.title: Reference audio
clips.hint: Clips are joined from top to bottom. Use Edit to cut silence or noise at either end, or to split a clip.
clips.removeConfirm: Delete this clip? This cannot be undone.
clips.total: {{seconds}} s in total (up to {{max}} s are used)
clips.over: Audio beyond {{max}} s is not used.
clips.short: {{target}} s or more in total gives a more stable voice.

editor.hint: Drag across the waveform to select a range; click to move the playback position.
editor.loadFailed: The waveform could not be loaded.
editor.otherModel: This voice was created with another model ({{model}}). It is re-encoded for this model when used.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its reference audio and recordings are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
editor.captionOnly: A caption-only voice without reference audio; it varies a little with every generation.
editor.addNeedsConsent: Adding audio files or recordings requires confirming the speaker's consent

embedding.missing: The speaker embedding file is missing. Replace it.

consent.title: Speaker consent
consent.statement: I have the consent of the person whose voice this is to use it for speech synthesis (or it is my own voice). I will not use it to impersonate them, to harm them or anyone else, or for any purpose that breaks the law or the Irodori-TTS terms of use.
consent.note: The confirmed statement and the time are recorded with this voice and included in its voice package.

defaults.title: Voice settings and defaults
defaults.hint: Loaded when you choose this voice in Quick generation.
defaults.caption: Default caption
defaults.loraHint: LoRA adapter folder used when generating with this voice.

audition.title: Listen
audition.hint: Reads the test sentence with the settings above, including unsaved changes.
audition.encoded: The reference audio was encoded during this generation (skipped from now on).

design.caption: Voice description (caption)
design.captionPlaceholder: Japanese, e.g. 落ち着いた低めの声の男性。やわらかく、ゆっくり話している。
design.captionHint: Describe timbre, age and manner of speaking in Japanese. Presets are appended at the end.
design.candidatesHint: Compare them and choose the one to save as a voice.
design.keepAudio: Save the chosen candidate as reference audio (recommended)
design.keepAudioHint: The candidate's audio becomes the voice's source, so it sounds the same from then on.
design.captionOnlyHint: Only the caption is saved; the voice varies a little with every generation.

problems.needText: Enter a sentence for the candidates.

record.hint: Find a quiet place, stay about 20–30 cm from the microphone and read in your natural voice. Press “Stop and add” after each sentence.

sentences.s1: It's a clear day today, so I think I'll walk to the park on the other side of town.
sentences.s2: The new bakery by the station opens at seven every morning.
sentences.s3: At yesterday's meeting we took our time going over next month's schedule.
sentences.s4: When I opened the window, a cool breeze drifted in with the scent of flowers.
sentences.s5: If you like, shall we go and see a film together this weekend?
sentences.s6: This book tells the story of a cat and a boy who live in a small town by the sea.
sentences.s7: Could you check whether there's any milk or eggs left in the fridge?
sentences.s8: When I looked up at the night sky, countless stars were shining.
sentences.s10: Take a slow, deep breath and let your shoulders relax.

record.clipped: The sound is clipping. Move a little away from the microphone or lower the input volume.
record.quiet: Your voice seems quiet. Move closer to the microphone or raise the input volume.

errors.denied: Microphone access is not allowed. Allow this app to use the microphone in your system settings.
errors.busy: The microphone cannot be used. Another app may be using it.
